  Expected change site: `.github/ai/alert_inbox.json` (Expected files; plan Phase 1 step 1 at docs/plans/alert-triage-auto-heal-plan.md:484-485; files_touched grant)
  Evidence of absence: The file is not on the PR head; `.github/ai/` contains claude_engine.json, claude_template_divergence.json, concurrency_caps.yml, consumer_repos.json, hot_files.json, label_contract.v1.json, orchestrate_schema.v1.json, smoke_test_repos.json, WORKFLOW.md and write_guards.v1.json. No changed file or LAST RUN DIFF creates it; `capture_enabled` matches only the comment at `.github/workflows/alert-inbox-intake.yml:9`. `tests/test_tg_helpers_alert_inbox.py:409` raises FileNotFoundError in tests-heal-plan-and-validation (1 failed, 95 passed) and tests-system-python (13) (run 43913644530). The test is correct. Content comes from docs/plans/alert-triage-auto-heal-plan.md:309-315 and :371-376. With both switches false the phase stays inert. The README row, changelog fragment and agents fragment only become accurate once the file exists. It must be added by a run whose sandbox admits the path; four autofix runs deferred it.
  SEVERITY: BLOCKER
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
- HARDENING: scripts/alert_inbox_capture.sh line 137 (`local server="${GITHUB_SERVER_URL:-https://github.com}"`) and jq `--arg run_url` (~line 243), with the api https check at lines 164-170. Only `api` is checked, but the store requires `https://github.com/<repo>/actions/runs/<id>` (scripts/alert_inbox_store.sh:103). With a non-github server, route mode has already suppressed Telegram (scripts/tg_helpers.sh:163-166) and the store rejects the record, so the alert is lost. Fix: add a `case "${server}"` check that fails the capture. Est. 6 lines.
- HARDENING: scripts/alert_inbox_capture.sh `alert_inbox_capture()` dispatch block (~lines 255-265, `${api}/repos/${_ALERT_INBOX_DISPATCH_REPO}/dispatches`). The capture does not check the source repo against the store's allow-list (scripts/alert_inbox_store.sh:98), so an unregistered repo gets a 204 and is then rejected with `source_repo_not_allowed`; in route mode the alert is dropped. Fix: read `.github/ai/consumer_repos.json` and fail the capture with `reason=source_repo_not_allowed`. Est. 10 lines.
- HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 2
